Why are airplane windows round instead of square?Airplane windows are rounded for crucial safety reasons, not aesthetics. Sharp corners on square windows caused dangerous stress concentrations and structural failures. Early jetliner accidents, like the de Havilland Comet, tragically highlighted this design flaw. Modern aircraft feature multi-pane windows and small bleed holes for pressure balance. These design elements ensure structural integrity and enhance passenger safety during flights.
